subject: reduce stack usage of XXH64 streaming variant
perf_evidence: Commit subject explicitly targets lower stack usage in XXH64 streaming.
change_summary: Reworks the XXH64 streaming update buffer handling to use less stack space.

units.name: public XXH64_reset/update/digest, 11 fixed streaming segment pairs
units.evidence: All 11 value-input streaming targets pass bidirectional Alive2. The segment pairs cover empty, short, block-boundary and longer updates.

notes: Input bytes and seed are symbolic, but update lengths and call sequences are a finite matrix; the proof does not cover every streaming sequence.
